variants.title: 星空の観測室
variants.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a standalone 16:9 landscape anime game title-screen background, one complete image, no panels.
Primary request: create a new title key visual featuring ONLY the two reference characters, Mizu (みず) and Ame (あめ).
Input images: Image 1 is the authoritative character identity and costume reference for Mizu. Image 2 is the authoritative character identity and costume reference for Ame. Image 3 is a supporting reference for the existing game's polished blue-toned anime key-visual style and spacious title composition ONLY; do not copy its character outfits where they differ from Images 1 and 2.
Character invariants: exactly two young adult women of university age, matching the two character reference images. Mizu has very long slate-ocean-blue hair with loosely half-up sides, a small white wave/infinity-shaped hair clip, blue eyes with warm gold highlights, a cream long-sleeved collared blouse with a mint ribbon, a dark teal belted below-knee pinafore dress, white socks and black Mary Jane shoes. Ame has a chin-length pale icy-blue bob, a small white cloud-shaped hair clip, blue-lavender eyes with warm gold highlights, an ivory collared knee-length dress with delicate pale-blue hem stripes and a pale-blue neck bow, a light icy-blue cable-knit button cardigan, white socks and pale-blue loafers. Preserve their distinctive faces, hair length, hair clips, costume colors and costume construction. Do not swap these traits.
Style/medium: beautifully finished Japanese anime illustration, delicate confident linework, expressive clean faces, luminous carefully controlled painted atmosphere, richly composed environment, cohesive high-end visual-novel title artwork, not chibi.
Text: none. No embedded title, logo, letters, captions, watermark or UI. Leave intentional calm negative space where the application's title will be overlaid.
Constraints: depict only Mizu and Ame; no third person, silhouettes of other people, crowd, duplicate reflections, mascots or animals. Natural hands and coherent anatomy. Fully clothed. One landscape illustration, not a collage.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet seaside observatory at night, tall open glass windows looking out over a tranquil blue bay and distant lighthouse. Stars and a luminous Earth-like blue planet in the upper-left sky recall the existing title art. A telescope and a few closed books at the far edges subtly establish an astronomy club room.
Composition/framing: sweeping 16:9 panorama. Mizu sits at the right near the window, body angled toward the bay but face turned in a warm three-quarter view toward us; Ame stands beside her, relaxed, looking toward Mizu with a gentle open-eyed smile. Both faces and their signature hair clips are clear. Keep the central-left 55 percent mostly uncluttered deep-blue sky for the separate game logo. Hands rest naturally, no pointing.
Lighting/mood: tranquil midnight blue, cyan starlight outlining their hair, restrained warm amber interior accents; a feeling of wonder and companionship. Character details must remain readable, not lost in darkness.
